name: bitcoin-batch-pir-web-client
description: Web client for Bitcoin Batch PIR system (two-level)

scripts.test:contract:direct-bolt11-two-provider: vitest run src/__tests__/product-admission-controller.test.ts -t "Direct BOLT11 DPF" && vitest run src/__tests__/adapter-lifecycle.test.ts -t "restores DPF fields from the verified native handle and consumes the batch once"
scripts.test:contract:shared-bat-two-provider: vitest run src/__tests__/provider-payment-selection.test.ts -t "rejects one paid issuer or origin by default and requires explicit opt-in|rejects a copied raw BAT key even if shared issuer correlation is explicitly allowed" && vitest run src/__tests__/product-admission-controller.test.ts -t "freezes planner demand at first acquisition and rechecks it before query"
scripts.test:e2e:payment-cdk-cashu: tsc -p tsconfig.payment-cdk-cashu-e2e.json --pretty false && playwright test --config playwright.payment-cdk-cashu.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:payment-cln-regtest: tsc -p tsconfig.payment-real-e2e.json && playwright test --config playwright.payment-cln-regtest.config.ts && playwright test --config playwright.payment-cln-joined.config.ts
